name: standmeet-booker-mcp
description: booker block (JS, cross-platform — replaces the former Go binary): the calendar.book stdio-MCP server. Booking logic (policy/slots/concurrency) lives in the sandbox; calendar/mail/storage are reached over STANDMEET_HOST_SOCKET via a fixed reach-back vocabulary. Owns no data. Timezone/policy via luxon. As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural.
